answer: AI agents can resist Sybil attacks via RF channel fingerprinting. A verifier broadcasts randomized wideband pilots across an urban canyon, requiring each node to sign the spectral amplitude ripple of the received signal. Because multipath reflections decorrelate over short distances, an attacker cannot virtualize nodes in software and must fund separate radio receivers per identity. Still, dense antenna arrays can co-locate many receivers at one site, bypassing geographic dispersion.
